About me

I'm Daberena, a legal professional with 2+ years of experience streamlining back-office operations and administrative support for independent attorneys and law firms.

My core strengths are proactive organization, flawless attention to detail, legal research (LexisNexis, Westlaw), and meticulous document drafting — including pleadings, contracts, motions, letters, and resolutions.

I leverage essential tools like Clio, PracticePanther, Docketwise, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Rocket Lawyer, and Adobe Acrobat to keep practice workflows organized and on schedule.

Driven by clear communication and collaboration, I aim to partner with agile corporate practices, international commercial law firms, business immigration teams, and personal law practices to deliver strategic operational support.
